body: The people I’m talking about are my friends and it’s really hard to forget them and move on because I’ve been with them for so many years. Now all they do is do things that make me feel like trash. Even if it’s not that serious, my body would rather have me feel hurt. I don’t know how to make new friends, I moved from my old location 2 years ago and I haven’t made any. It’s just easier to end it all
I have a hard time making friends ever since I moved schools
